description: Lists employees in a selected department for business users.
purpose: Answer employee-directory questions with a controlled parameterized query.
instructions: Provide the department name as text. Matching is case-insensitive and ignores leading or trailing spaces.
source: SELECT employee_id, first_name, last_name, email, department, job_title, salary, hire_date FROM PDBDBA.EMPLOYEES WHERE UPPER(TRIM(department)) = UPPER(TRIM(:department_name)) ORDER BY last_name, first_name

variables.name: department_name
variables.description: Department name to search for, such as Sales or Finance.
